name: @qu/space-storage
description: Qu V5: persistence adapters for @qu/space-core. Stores the exact same signed+encrypted envelope objects that go out over @qu/space-transport - at-rest and in-transit are the same opaque ciphertext, never a separate re-encryption step. memoryStore = ephemeral (session/memory tier, lost on process exit); durableStore = simulates a real disk/DB-backed store within one process, for tests; fileStore = REAL on-disk persistence (one file per Node), used by the relay-server/Docker deployment.
